description: Definitions DJ records share: tracks (with their artists and how each came in), keys, the people a DJ plays with, shares and counts.

track.description: One track: named (a title, usually an artist), or unidentified. isrc, recordingMbId, releaseName, releaseMbId and artists are named and shaped as in teal.fm's records, so readers can map them.

artist.description: The artist credit as the track is tagged: one line, however many artists it names.

artists.description: The artists the credit names, one by one in its order, when the writer can tell them apart.

releaseName.description: The release (album, EP or single) it's from.

recordingMbId.description: The MusicBrainz recording ID URI, formatted as mbid:<uuid>.

releaseMbId.description: The MusicBrainz release ID URI, formatted as mbid:<uuid>.

bpmCentis.description: Its tempo as the writer's analysis has it, in hundredths of a BPM (12800 is 128 BPM).

startSeconds.description: When it starts, in seconds from the start of the set or mix it's in (known from a recording).

transitionIn.description: How it was brought in over the track before it. Absent on the first track, and when unknown.

unidentified.description: Not named: the DJ chose not to say what it is (an unreleased promo, an edit), so only its place is published.

artist.description: One artist a track credits, shaped as teal.fm's artist.

artistMbId.description: The MusicBrainz artist ID URI, formatted as mbid:<uuid>.

transition.description: How a track was brought in over the one before it, named and shaped as skaists' performance transition (technique, durationMs), with what a recording also tells: how the keys and tempo moved. Absent means unknown, not a cut.

technique.description: How it was mixed in. unknown: the writer heard the change but can't tell how it was made.

durationMs.description: How long both tracks were heard together, in milliseconds.

harmony.description: How the keys heard relate on the Camelot wheel (after any pitch change from the tempo). sameKey: the same key. adjacent: one step round the wheel. relative: the same number, minor to major or back. energyBoost: two steps up, or a semitone up. clash: none of those.

tempoChangePermille.description: How much the tempo played changed, in tenths of a percent (25 is 2.5% faster, -10 is 1% slower).

camelotKey.description: A key on the Camelot wheel, 1A to 12B (8A is A minor, 8B C major).

share.description: A name (a genre, label or artist) and its share of plays.

count.description: How many: count when exact, atLeast when rounded down to a round number. One of the two.
